$comment: Environment variables this brick depends on. Read by `fonderie env`, the admin console and check:env-declarations — docs/ENV-DECLARATIONS-DESIGN.md

vars.name: S3_BUCKET
vars.description: Bucket name. It must already exist.

vars.name: S3_ENDPOINT
vars.description: Endpoint for S3-compatible stores (MinIO, R2, B2). Unset: AWS.

vars.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
vars.description: Access key ID. Set both keys or neither (neither: the AWS default credential chain).

vars.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
vars.description: Secret access key. Set both keys or neither.

vars.name: STORAGE_DIR
vars.description: Directory the local-filesystem provider writes to.
